title: Sum of First N Numbers
statement: Given an integer N, print the sum of the first N natural numbers.

title: Reverse a Number
statement: Given a non-negative integer N, print the number obtained by reversing its digits. If N is 0, output 0.
hints: You can reverse the input as text, then parse it as an integer.
Or repeatedly use n % 10 and n / 10.

title: Count Vowels in a String
statement: Given one line of text, count the vowels a, e, i, o and u. Matching must be case-insensitive.
hints: Convert the string to lowercase with ToLowerInvariant().
Check whether each character occurs in the string "aeiou".

title: FizzBuzz
statement: Given N, print lines from 1 to N. Multiples of 3 become Fizz, multiples of 5 become Buzz, and multiples of both become FizzBuzz.

tests.output:
1
2
Fizz
4
Buzz
Fizz
7
8
Fizz
Buzz
11
Fizz
13
14
FizzBuzz

hints: Check divisibility by 15 before checking 3 or 5.

title: Palindrome Check
statement: Read a word and print YES if it reads the same forward and backward, otherwise print NO. Compare case-insensitively.
hints: You can compare characters from the two ends or reverse the character array.

title: Second Largest Distinct Number
statement: The first input line contains space-separated integers. Print the second largest distinct value.
hints: Order the distinct values descending and take the second item.
